tools.name: search_knowledge_base
tools.description: BM25 full-text search in rafsoft.net knowledge base (FAQ, docs, blog, pricing). Returns relevant content about Faktura VAT (2026 and 2027) Polish invoicing software.

query.description: Search query in Polish or English

tools.name: get_product_info
tools.description: Returns product and pricing info for Faktura VAT (Windows: 2026 + 2027) and Mobilna Faktura (plans, prices in PLN, download URLs, purchase links).

section.description: Section: all (default), product, pricing (cennik), downloads, mobilna

tools.name: compare_editions
tools.description: Compare Faktura VAT 2027 editions START vs STANDARD vs PRO: prices (PLN net, one-time purchase — no subscription) and a full feature availability matrix (KSeF 2.0, JPK, magazyn, KPiR, CRM, e-commerce integrations...).

onlyDifferences.description: Return only features that differ between the selected editions

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: FAQ for Faktura VAT (Polish, question/answer pairs). Sources: "program" (sections: Instalacja i aktualizacja, Licencja i rejestracja, Konfiguracja programu, Operacje w programie, Wygląd dokumentu i wydruku), "ksef" (sections: Podstawowe informacje o KSeF 2.0, Faktury zagraniczne i prywatni klienci, Faktury zakupowe, Typy faktur, Wieloprofilowość, UPO i przywracanie faktur, JST, Rozwiązywanie problemów).

section.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on section name

tools.name: get_ksef_info
tools.description: KSeF 2.0 (Polish national e-invoicing system) info: how Faktura VAT integrates with KSeF, supported invoice types, FA(3) validator, KSeF Client features, troubleshooting FAQ. All editions (START/STANDARD/PRO) include KSeF support.

topic.description: Topic (default all): integracja = integration guide, faq = KSeF FAQ, tabela-faktur = supported invoice types, ksef-client = KSeF Client features, walidator = FA(3) validator
